title: Nityam CanvasDoc
description: A notebook the tutor and the student share. Pages of typed blocks; every block registers the regions that MEAN something, so a highlight or a circle can be resolved back to a concept rather than a rectangle. Sibling of the Artifact IR: the agent writes this document, a hand-written runtime interprets it.

concepts.description: Concept ids this notebook touches. Anchors tag themselves with these, which is how a gesture becomes evidence for the student model.

label.description: Shown in the page rail, e.g. 'Why 45 degrees'.

anchor.description: A region with meaning. The unit of grounding: what a gesture resolves TO.

span.description: tutor_text / callout: the exact substring to wrap. Must occur in the block's text.

element.description: diagram: a CSS selector into the block's own SVG, e.g. '#vec-ux'.

concept.description: Concept id, so a gesture on this anchor is concept-tagged evidence.

note.description: One line the tutor can use when this anchor is pointed at.

misconception.description: Marking THIS anchor is itself evidence of this misconception (e.g. circling u when asked about vertical velocity).

terms.description: equation: rendered as spans, NOT a maths library. No external dependency, and every term is independently anchorable - which is the whole point.

tex.description: Display text for the term. Plain unicode; a few \commands are mapped by the renderer.

over.description: Numerator when this term is a fraction; `tex` is then the denominator.

plain.description: Operators and brackets: rendered, but not anchorable.

svg.description: diagram: inline SVG markup. Elements carrying an id become anchor targets.

src.description: image: a URL or data URI. Must be same-origin or inline for the crop fallback to work.

kind.description: image: where it came from. Shown to the student as provenance.

regions.description: image: anchorable hotspots in fractional coordinates [x, y, w, h] of the rendered image.

artifact_ir.description: artifact: filename of an Artifact IR, inlined at build time and mounted with Nityam.mountArtifact().

theme.description: artifact: which theme token set to resolve it with.

prompt.description: student_work: what the student is being asked to do in this space.
